entities.summary: Neil Allison Campbell was an American scientist best known for his textbook, Campbell Biology, first published in 1987. The textbook was significantly updated in subsequent editions by American biologists Jane Reece and Lisa Urry, being used by over 700,000 students in both high school and college-level classes.
